qualification.title: Qualification criteria
qualification.intro: We work with a limited number of qualified businesses. Before starting, we assess:
items: The maturity and stability of your business.
Your capacity to invest in a system, not just a campaign.
The alignment between your objectives and our approach.
Your availability to engage in the process.

investment.title: Investment
investment.text: We do not display a fixed public price. Investment depends on the complexity, scope, and current situation of the business. It is defined after the strategy call, based on your objectives.
investment.note: The strategy call determines the exact scope and the right investment structure.

steps.title: System Design
steps.text: We design the full architecture: acquisition, conversion, CRM, follow-up, and measurement as one coherent whole.

steps.title: Traffic & Trust

real-estate-developers.name: Real Estate Developers
real-estate-developers.short: Structure the sale of long-cycle developments with rigorous acquisition and follow-up.

real-estate-developers.conversion: Qualification, appointment booking, structured follow-up, and multichannel reminders through to decision.

real-estate-agencies.name: Real Estate Agencies
real-estate-agencies.short: Generate a steady flow of qualified buyers and sellers, without relying only on referrals.

real-estate-agencies.conversion: Capture, fast qualification, appointment booking, and structured WhatsApp follow-up.

hotels-riads.name: Hotels & Riads
hotels-riads.short: Increase direct bookings and reduce dependency on third-party platforms.
hotels-riads.system: A direct-booking system supported by content, targeted campaigns, and client follow-up.
hotels-riads.conversion: Optimized landing pages, clear direct offers, and follow-up on unconverted inquiries.

automotive.name: Automotive
automotive.short: Generate qualified inquiries and structure sales follow-up for dealerships and automotive players.
automotive.system: An acquisition and qualification system connected to a CRM and fast follow-up.
automotive.conversion: Immediate qualification, appointment booking, and documented sales follow-up.

car-rental.name: Car Rental
car-rental.short: Maximize bookings and fleet utilization with an effective acquisition system.
car-rental.system: A direct-booking system with targeted acquisition and automated follow-up.
car-rental.conversion: Booking landing pages, fast response, and inquiry follow-up.

private-clinics.name: Private Clinics
private-clinics.short: Attract the right patients for the right services, with a respectful, professional system.
private-clinics.system: An acquisition system by specialty, connected to structured, respectful patient follow-up.
private-clinics.conversion: Simplified appointment booking, qualification, and appropriate follow-up.

service-businesses.name: High-Value Service Businesses
service-businesses.short: Structure the acquisition and sale of high-value services, with premium positioning.
service-businesses.system: A complete system linking positioning, acquisition, qualification, and a documented sales process.
service-businesses.conversion: Qualification, discovery calls, proposals, and structured follow-up.

hero.title: We build systems, not promises.
hero.subtitle: HighSysteme is a business transformation and growth company that helps established businesses structure their acquisition, sales, and digital presence.

vision.title: Vision
vision.text: A world where business growth rests on clear, measurable systems — not on luck, improvisation, or dependency on a single person.

mission.title: Mission
mission.text: To help established businesses transform their acquisition, sales process, and digital presence into a structured, measurable, and scalable system.

philosophy.title: Strategic philosophy
philosophy.text: We believe strategy precedes execution, that decisions must rest on data, and that a good system makes a business less dependent on individual effort. We prefer building durable assets over chasing fleeting results.

items: We start by understanding before proposing.

We work with a limited number of clients to protect quality.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This policy explains how HighSysteme collects, uses, and protects your data. It must be reviewed and completed by a qualified professional before launch.

sections.title: Data we collect
sections.text: We collect the information you provide via our forms (name, company, contact details, business information) as well as anonymous technical browsing data.

sections.title: Use of data
sections.text: We use your data to assess your request, contact you, deliver our services, and improve our site. We do not sell your data.

sections.title: Data sharing
sections.text: Your data may be processed by technical providers (hosting, CRM, payment) solely as part of our services.

sections.title: Retention
sections.text: We keep your data as long as needed for the described purposes or as required by law.

sections.title: Your rights
sections.text: You can request access, correction, or deletion of your data by contacting us.

sections.title: Security
sections.text: We implement reasonable measures to protect your data. No method is completely infallible.

sections.title: Contact
sections.text: For any question about this policy, contact us using the details provided on this site.

terms.title: Terms and Conditions
terms.intro: These terms govern the use of the HighSysteme website and services. They must be reviewed and completed by a qualified professional before launch.

sections.title: Purpose
